title: Name feature URNs feature:{wagon}:{verb-object}, built via URNBuilder.feature

facts.note: Any artifact or code that can construct, declare or reference a feature URN; narrowed further by the change fact below.
Declaring, renaming, or writing/updating a reference to a feature URN.

values: value matching 'feature:' URN added or modified
URN construction for a feature added or modified
facts.note: Diff-level observer extracting feature: URN strings and feature-URN construction sites in any file.
Task mentions defining, naming or referencing a feature.

fires: A new feature is declared under a wagon with its URN.
A feature is renamed or moved to another wagon, changing its URN.
A plan, wagon, acceptance or doc artifact adds or updates a reference to a feature URN.
doesNotFire: Editing a feature's description or acceptances without touching any feature URN.
Naming a wagon URN alone (covered by the wagon URN-naming convention).

given: A feature URN is being constructed, declared, renamed or referenced in any artifact or code
when: The feature URN value is written or changed
then: The feature URN must be built via URNBuilder.feature and have the form feature:{wagon}:{feature}, both segments kebab-case (matching ^feature:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$), with the feature segment in {verb}-{object} form.
prefer: Use the parent wagon's slug verbatim as the {wagon} segment.
Shape the feature segment as verb-object, e.g. feature:resolve-dilemmas:choose-option, feature:manage-inventory:track-stock, feature:manage-users:authenticate-user.
avoid: Hand-concatenating feature URN strings instead of using URNBuilder.feature.
Uppercase, underscores, camelCase or segments starting with a digit or hyphen.
Noun-only or object-verb feature names (e.g. stock-tracking instead of track-stock).
Omitting the wagon segment or adding extra colon-separated segments.
why: The feature URN is the feature identifier, so it must have one fixed, checkable form.
evidence: Every feature URN in the diff matches ^feature:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.
Feature URNs are produced through URNBuilder.feature.
The {wagon} segment equals the owning wagon's slug.
The feature segment reads as {verb}-{object} (reviewer/LLM judgment).
verifier_detail: Term feature_urn ('the feature identifier.'): values.pattern = ^feature:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ ; values.naming = '{verb}-{object}'.
Pattern check is mechanical; verb-object naming is llm_judged (first hyphen token should be a verb).
Valid reference examples: feature:resolve-dilemmas:choose-option, feature:manage-inventory:track-stock, feature:manage-users:authenticate-user.
